prompt: Some people believe that governments should encourage people to use public transport instead of private cars. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Nowadays, traffic congestion has become an important issue in many countries around the world. Some people believe that governments should encourage individuals to use public transport instead of their own car. I agree with this opinion because it develops the country’s economy  and reduces pollution in the city.

To begin with, one of the main reasons why I agree is that public transport helps to improve the country’s economy. This is because it helps people to reduce spending on fuel and car maintenance. This allows people to save more money and spend it on other things. As a result, this can increase spending at local stores and companies, which helps to develop the country’s economy. For example, people who use buses or trains may save money monthly, and can spend this money on stores and local restaurants. Therefore, this helps local companies grow.

Moreover, another important reason is that using public transport helps to reduce air pollution in the cities. This is because one bus can carry many people instead of using a lot of cars. This means that there will be fewer cars on the road, which reduces harmful carbon emissions and preserves people’s health. For instance, enhancing air quality in the cities may reduce people’s health problems, especially for children and older people. As a result, people can live in a healthier and safer environment.

In conclusion, I believe that governments should encourage individuals to use buses and trains because it assists in improving the economy and decreasing air pollution.
